[[Category:Probability]]
A '''categorical distribution''' is the result distribution of a single draw from a finite set of $K$ mutually exclusive outcomes.

It is parameterised by the '''probability vector'''

$$
\vec p=(p_1,\dots,p_K),\,  p_i\ge 0,\, \sum_{i=1}^K p_i=1,
$$

== Interpretation ==

$$
Y\sim \operatorname{Categorical}(\vec p) \equiv \forall i\in\{1,\dots,K\}: P(Y=i)=p_i.
$$
